model: ANUGA 4.0.1 2D shallow-water, 30 m SRTM DEM, ~300 m mesh, uniform Manning n = 0.035
notes: Flood extent is cut off at the east edge of the model box, so area and exposure are lower bounds.
The published-peak scenario takes its peak flow from the published HEC-RAS study (Bharath et al., 2021); it is an input, not a prediction.
Arrival of peak depth in this model is 2-3 times slower than the published study, so it must not be used for evacuation lead time.
Exposure counts people (WorldPop 2020, modelled) and land cover (ESA WorldCover 2021) inside the flood footprint. It is not a casualty or monetary-loss estimate.
Depth in narrow gorges and wide flat plains is poorly resolved by the 30 m DEM and ~300 m mesh.
The reservoir area upstream of the dam is excluded.

validation.published_study: Bharath et al. (2021), Environmental Challenges 5, 100401 (1D HEC-RAS, overtopping scenario)
validation.note: Published area is for a 22 river-km stretch. The published-peak model run floods 79.0 km2 within 15 km and 116.8 km2 within 22 km straight-line distance of the dam.
